title: Int128 & Overflow Headroom
hints: `multipliedReportingOverflow(by:)` returns the product and an overflow flag.
jsBridge: `Int128` (Swift 6) gives 128-bit integers with the same trap-on-overflow rules. JS `BigInt` is arbitrary-precision (never overflows) but slower. Swift gives you fixed headroom at native speed.

compass.q: `BigInt` never overflows. `Int128` does, just much later. When would you prefer each?
